# Loopy Timer

> Free online interval timer for Tabata, HIIT, EMOM and Pomodoro. Run multiple timers at once, build your own work / rest cycles and share your results. No sign-up.

Loopy Timer is a free interval timer for Tabata, HIIT, EMOM, Pomodoro and your own cycles. Run several timers at the same time, right in your browser. No sign-up, no install.

## Features
- Several timers running at once, each with its own work / rest cycle
- Presets for Tabata, HIIT, EMOM and Pomodoro, or build your own
- Sound cues, saved timers and offline use as an installable web app
- Share your finished workout or focus session as text or an image

## Ready-made timers (English)
- [Pomodoro](https://timer.eastazy.com/en/pomodoro-timer/): The Pomodoro Technique alternates 25 minutes of focused work with 5-minute breaks. This timer starts at 25 min work / 5 min rest × 4 rounds, and you can change it any time.
- [Tabata](https://timer.eastazy.com/en/tabata-timer/): Tabata is a high-intensity interval format: 20 seconds of all-out effort and 10 seconds of rest, repeated 8 times (4 minutes). This timer adds a 10-second get-ready countdown.
- [HIIT](https://timer.eastazy.com/en/hiit-timer/): A simple HIIT plan: 40 seconds of hard work and 20 seconds of rest, 10 rounds per set, 2 sets with a 1-minute break in between. Adjust the times to your level.
- [EMOM 10](https://timer.eastazy.com/en/emom-timer/): EMOM means “every minute on the minute”: work for 45 seconds, rest for 15, and start the next round on the minute. This timer runs 10 rounds.

## FAQ
- Is Loopy Timer free? Yes. It is free to use, needs no account and runs in your browser.
- Can I run more than one timer at once? Yes. Add as many timers as you like and start them independently, for example a Tabata set and a Pomodoro session side by side.
- Are my timers saved? Timers are saved in your browser, so they come back after a reload. Your timers are never uploaded. You can also add the app to your home screen and use it offline.
